subject.title: fix(codex): reject hex/exponent computer wait duration strings

question: Should direct production-helper evidence be accepted for this Codex watchdog change, or should merge require a real Codex app-server-to-computer roundtrip demonstrating the changed request path?
rationale: Repository policy requires the reviewer to inspect the sibling Codex contract directly and requires external PRs to show after-fix behavior in a real setup; the supplied proof explicitly stops short of the live app-server path.

options.title: Require live roundtrip proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Codex app-server-to-computer terminal or log transcript covering rejected hexadecimal duration and one accepted strict numeric-string case.

options.title: Accept helper-boundary proof
options.body: Treat the direct production resolver invocation and focused test as sufficient if the Codex-extension owner confirms that no additional runtime transformation occurs.

recommendation.title: Require live roundtrip proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Codex app-server-to-computer terminal or log transcript covering rejected hexadecimal duration and one accepted strict numeric-string case.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor authored the patch and supplied the existing proof; they are the available contact for adding the requested runtime evidence.
